data.body: /dso:fix-bug BASIC investigation: review_mirror_defenses_to_pr in review-github-defense-store.sh drops 1 of 3 records when defense_text contains exotic bytes (backticks, code fences, embedded quotes). Likely cause: github_defense_store_write passes JSON body via --body interpolation, breaking on embedded markdown chars. Proposed fix: switch from 'gh pr comment --body "$json"' to --body-file <(cat) or a temp file; re-enable exotic-byte stress in tests/integration/test-mirror-defenses-round-trip.sh. Classification: MODERATE — bounded bash logic fix in one script + un-defer existing stress test. Not addressed in this P2 pass; leaving OPEN.
